# Projul

> Construction management software and comprehensive contractor resource hub covering project management, compliance, safety, and business operations.

Projul provides construction CRM software alongside in-depth guides for contractors on topics ranging from OSHA compliance and Davis-Bacon certified payroll to AI technology, financial management, and business exit strategies. The platform serves general contractors, specialty trades, and construction business owners seeking operational excellence.

## Key Topics

- Projul CRM
- OSHA compliance
- Construction management software
- Davis-Bacon Act & WH-347
- Certified payroll
- Project management
- QuickBooks integration
- Contractor safety protocols
- Site logistics & staging
- Construction financial management
- ANSI Z535 standards
- Construction technology & AI
- Bonding capacity
- Contractor software comparisons
